leakage_audit_verdict.finding: The 500 observations evaluated for spatial uncertainty containment originated from the same CALIBRATION_SPLIT used to tune factor k = 2.24. Presenting 97.60% as an independent validation score constituted test-set contamination. The metric has been formally reclassified as 'in-sample calibration coverage'.

post_calibration_evaluation.recommendation: Independent out-of-sample coverage verification should be performed in future operational pilot testing.
